summary.en: Three days ago, Mutsumi Seino suddenly told her husband Daiichiro and her mother-in-law Ura that all of them should move away like what the Sasakis did that morning because Mrs.Sasaki told her that they were fleeing from their cursed house, which both Daiichiro and Ura laughed it off. The next night, Mutsumi told her husband that she was experiencing symptoms often seen in a cold–which she just put all the blame on the curse, and demanded everyone to move away before things could have gotten any worse. Daiichiro decided to peek at the house this morning since he was worried about his wife’s behavior. He is doing so when spotted by Conan and Kogoro, who then decide to take on the case when Daiichiro mentions the house is cursed. In Mouri Detective Agency, Daiichiro recounts the situation to Kogoro and Conan, and how rushed Mutsumi was when convincing everyone to move away. Kogoro then calls the Sasakis to ask why they moved–they moved away because of work, and did not mention anything about the rumor. Kogoro then asks Daiichiro if his wife showed any change in her behavior, which he recalls the morning three days before: "When he was watering the plants, Mutsumi went home from shopping. However, she looked dazed while mentioning something five years ago that was not over." Kogoro and Conan discuss the situation again after Daiichiro goes home, and conclude that Mutsumi wanted to move away so that the mistake she made five years ago remained a secret. They choose to go to the Seino residence to talk it out with her about the mistake. Meanwhile, Daiichiro receives information from a hospital that Mutsumi fell down the steps at the Beika Station, so he needs to go see his wife there. He is about to leave when he runs into Kogoro and Conan, who allow him to do so upon hearing the situation. Moments later, Daiichiro and Mutsumi get to the location with a taxi, but the husband leaves to buy the bandages he was supposed to buy on their way home, letting his wife confront Kogoro and Conan alone as they expose her lies. Self-defense? (past) Location: Kazahaya Art Museum Park Victim: Kenji Murakumo Age: 25 years old (five years ago) Time: Five years ago Cause of death: Blunt force trauma on the back of his head Suspects: Mutsumi Seino, and Atsuko Uryu Mutsumi confesses having pushed a man when he tried to grab her five years before. However, news reports on the next day showed that the man had died from a blow on the back of his head. She also ran into Atsuko Uryu when she just started to slip away. Eventually, she confesses the past mistake she made five years ago when she was visiting Kazahaya Art Museum: "She was at the park outside when a drunkard named Kenji Murakumo tried to grab her. She pushed him away, and once she saw him lying unconscious on his side, she slipped away from the scene before running into Atsuko Uryu, who was going in the opposite direction. On the next day, she saw news of Murakumo's death on TV, and was worried since the police could come at any moment to arrest her, which hadn’t happened since." The reason she demanded to move away was that she saw Uryu again one week ago, as Uryu moved in her neighborhood half a month ago, and was afraid that Uryu would report her to the police if the two ran into each other again. The catch is she needed a reason to do so, which was sparked when she saw the Sasakis moving away. Now, she has come up with the decision to turn herself in to the police. Just then, Conan asks how she got injured, and she recalls that she was pushed by someone from behind. Moreover, she presents the letter she found in the family mailbox, which she believes to be the punishment she deserved for lying. Location: Beika Station Victim: Mutsumi Seino Method: Pushing from the top of the steps Suspects: Mutsumi Seino At first, Conan suspects Mutsumi for faking her accident. However, it turns out that someone pushed her. Moments after Mutsumi leaves the park, Kogoro and Conan decide to look into the case five years ago to see if it can help with the bizarre letter. The two arrive at Kazahaya city police department where Kogoro meets Hitoshi Yukigaya, a police detective he worked with in a robbery case during his time on the force. They learn from the police perspective that the people who reported the body to the police were, in fact, an elderly couple. The case was tough because they didn’t get a single tip about any suspicious people in the area, thus Mutsumi never came up in the investigation. Moreover, the case went unsolved with the direction that Murakumo was killed by someone who had a grudge on him because they found nothing conclusive on the possible suspects.
